tagline: Leading Pure-Play Self-Care Company Providing Health and Wellness Solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin is the key KPI for Perrigo, a market leader in OTC self-care personal products. It reflects the company's ability to maintain profitability amid inflationary pressures, tariffs and rising raw material costs. This is an essential indicator for a fast-moving consumer goods company.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue remaining after paying production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin impacted by rising raw material costs, geopolitical tensions and U.S. tariffs. Strategic pricing actions and supply chain reinvention initiatives have helped mitigate impacts.
kpis.signal: Margin under pressure from inflation and tariffs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin declines due to persistent inflationary costs, organizational adjustments and investments in efficiency programs including Project Energize.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Capital expenditure reduced in 2024, notably deferring the Nutrition Network Optimization project, as part of cost rationalization and working capital optimization initiatives.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in capital investments in 2024.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Perrigo continues organizational rationalization with declining headcount through efficiency programs including Project Energize, supporting margin stabilization objectives.
kpis.signal: Continued headcount reduction as part of transformation.

kpis.name: Total Revenue

kpis.signal: Total revenue of 4.25B€ in the most recent year

risks.title: Cybersecurity threats and security incidents
risks.score_rationale: The risk is discussed in detail in the 10-K with emphasis on governance through the CISO and NGC, indicating high concern. Language emphasizes formal protocols, testing and third-party vendors, which confirms the importance of the risk. Compared to the prior year, explicit mention of certifications and protocols reinforces risk intensity. Category heavily weighted due to exposure to sensitive data.

risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainties
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in risk factors, this risk is described as directly affecting sales, margins and cash flows. Language is strong ('dynamic', 'adverse effect'). Mention of current operational modifications indicates real pressure. Category critical for low-margin fast-moving consumer goods.

risks.title: New U.S. tariffs
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly cites the announcement of new tariffs in 2025 as a direct threat. While not quantified, the potential impact is described as negative. The risk is new to the text compared to the prior year, with concerned language. Weighting is high due to international exposure.

risks.title: Dependence on key management personnel
risks.score_rationale: Recent changes in multiple leadership positions (CEO, CFO, CBO, etc.) are documented. While governance is solid, high turnover may impact strategic continuity. Language is neutral, but transition context warrants vigilance. Category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Change in financial segment structure
risks.score_rationale: Shift to category-based segmentation is presented as strategic, but entails operational adjustment and communication risks. Language is positive, but structural change carries uncertainties. Mentioned in 'Recent Developments', indicating active evolution. Category classified as moderate risk.

ai_positioning.summary: PRGO does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report.
